examples.name: Titled form with a required legend and end-aligned actions
examples.jsx:
<Form title="Create a new repository" requiredLegend onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <FormSection>
    <Field label="Repository name" required>
      <TextField placeholder="my-project" />
    </Field>
    <Field label="Description">
      <TextArea placeholder="A short description" />
    </Field>
  </FormSection>
  <FormFooter align="end">
    <Button appearance="subtle" type="button">Cancel</Button>
    <Button appearance="primary" type="submit">Create repository</Button>
  </FormFooter>
</Form>

examples.name: Two fields on one row
examples.jsx:
<Form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <FormSection>
    <FormRow>
      <Field label="First name" required><TextField /></Field>
      <Field label="Last name" required><TextField /></Field>
    </FormRow>
  </FormSection>
  <FormFooter><Button appearance="primary" type="submit">Continue</Button></FormFooter>
</Form>

examples.name: Multiple titled sections
examples.jsx:
<Form title="Project settings" requiredLegend onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <FormSection title="General">
    <Field label="Project name" required><TextField /></Field>
  </FormSection>
  <FormSection title="Danger zone">
    <Field label="Rename repository"><TextField /></Field>
  </FormSection>
  <FormFooter align="end"><Button appearance="primary" type="submit">Save changes</Button></FormFooter>
</Form>

examples.name: Start-aligned footer
examples.jsx:
<Form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <FormSection>
    <Field label="Email"><TextField type="email" /></Field>
  </FormSection>
  <FormFooter align="start">
    <Button appearance="primary" type="submit">Subscribe</Button>
  </FormFooter>
</Form>

antiExamples.name: A single standalone control wrapped in a Form
antiExamples.reason: A lone control that isn't submitted with others doesn't need a Form - use Field (or the bare control) directly.

antiExamples.name: Managing field validation state in the Form
antiExamples.jsx: <Form>{/* Form tracking each field's error state */}</Form>
antiExamples.reason: Form is layout only. Validation and error state live on Field (state="error") and the native control, not on Form.

antiExamples.name: A non-submit primary action
antiExamples.reason: Give the submit Button type="submit" so Enter-to-submit and the form's onSubmit work; don't rely on onClick alone.

antiExamples.name: Five fields in one row
antiExamples.reason: A row is for up to 4 equal columns (per Figma); more becomes too cramped - split into multiple rows.
